problem.title: Local metric homogeneity forcing periodic triangulations
problem.statement: Let the Euclidean plane or hyperbolic plane have a triangulation whose triangles have diameter at most $r$. Suppose that for every pair of radius-$r$ metric balls centered at vertices, an ambient isometry maps one ball to the other while respecting the triangulation. Must the triangulation be periodic?
